subject: Session affinity exception request for BrightLane POC
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@brightlane.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Session affinity exception request for BrightLane POC

Hi Marta and team,

Quick context: BrightLane is running a POC (BL-3472) on our hosted stack and the field team hit a problem that appears tied to session affinity + multi-variant routing. During longer chat sessions (10k+ tokens) they intermittently see model state drift where subsequent prompts appear to hit a different variant and the KV cache looks inconsistent. They reproduced locally and gave us a short trace (attached).

Ask: can Platform temporarily apply an exception for BrightLane's POC route so we can turn off session-affinity for their route or shorten the affinity window? We want to validate whether affinity is the causal factor before proposing a product change.

What I can provide:
- Repro steps and curl snippet from BrightLane (they supplied timestamps)
- Trace snippet (trace-snippet.txt) showing route selection for requests
- Proposal: change affinity window from 5m to 15s for the POC route for 24 hours during a maintenance window.

Risk/impact: low to moderate — affects only the POC route, may increase latency variance. We need to time this for after-hours CET to avoid demos.

Attachments: trace-snippet.txt (small), session-affinity-network-diagram.png

Next steps: looking for Platform/Runtime advice + approval to schedule the toggle. Logan / Marissa — tagging you for feasibility and estimated lead time.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Session affinity exception request for BrightLane POC

Thanks Lauren — looping in Sean and Marissa from Platform.

Couple quick clarifying Qs before we flip anything:
- Do we have a reproducible request id / time window we can replay in staging? The trace helps but we prefer a deterministic replay.
- Is this only happening when a request routes between variants (A/B) or when sessions are warmed/cold?
- Are they using any custom route hints or route-weights in headers?

If we have a reproducible curl + payload, Platform can spin a targeted canary (single worker pool, affinity disabled) and run the same sequence. If the canary reproduces, we can agree to the temporary exception (toggle per-route). If not, we'll need to look at K/V cache eviction logic.

I can try a staging replay today if Marta can share the curl + timestamps. CC @Marissa — can you confirm that per-route affinity toggle exists in the admin console and whether it can be scoped to the POC token? If we need a config change we'll estimate time.

- Logan
Logan Wright | Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@brightlane.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLane POC <poc+brightlane@brightlane.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Session affinity exception request for BrightLane POC

Thanks Lauren/Logan — sending the quick repro details below. We hit the drift twice yesterday in the 15:40-15:55 UTC window.

Repro (trimmed):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat 
   -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_test_brightlane" 
   -d '{"model":"open-redwood-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start"}, {"role":"user","content":"add more context..."}], "session_id":"bl-session-9ad2" }'
2) Wait ~7 minutes, send follow-up prompt in same session_id.

Observed: follow-up returns responses inconsistent with the last few turns (different style/length). We captured a request-id list and attached logs (brightlane-repro-logs.zip).

Notes: we are not sending any route-weight hints; this is plain SDK usage. Happy to give access to a prod trace if needed (we can provide a redacted view).

Marta
Marta Silva | Engineering Lead, BrightLane
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Session affinity exception request for BrightLane POC

Thanks for the details. Quick triage notes and a suggested plan below.

Initial triage:
- Reviewed trace-snippet.txt and brightlane-repro-logs.zip (thanks). Route selection shows two variant handoffs occurring close to the 7–8 minute mark. The runtime affinity TTL currently defaults to 5 minutes for this environment, which can cause a session to fall back to default routing if a worker pool is replaced or rebalanced.
- Hypothesis: affinity TTL + scheduling preemption for spot-like workers is causing the observed variant mismatch and KV cache miss.

Proposal (short-lived mitigation):
1) Apply per-route override: set affinity TTL=15s for BrightLane POC route and pin to single variant in staging (no multi-variant routing) for a 24-hour test.
2) Run deterministic replay using the request ids in brightlane-repro-logs.zip in our staging canary (I can run this).
3) If the replay passes, schedule a controlled prod toggle (maintenance window) and monitor per-request cache hits, variant churn, and latency.

Operational notes:
- We have an admin toggle that can be scoped to route+customer token; toggling should not require infra deploy but will require a brief config push (~30m) and a maintenance window.
- I will create a monitoring dashboard and an alert on variant churn > 2% over baseline for the duration of the test.

Requesting approval from Sales (Lauren) to schedule the maintenance window tonight at 01:00 UTC. Also tagging @Sean for SLA/incident implications.

Playbook ref: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/platform/session-affinity-playbook.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Platform Lead, Runtime

Lauren
